recommendations.recommendation: Make others depend on you rather than earning their gratitude.
recommendations.rationale: Those who need you honor you; once satisfied, people turn their backs on the well.
recommendations.conditions: do not leave them so in need that they come to harm

recommendations.recommendation: Keep your intentions hidden and do not show all your cards.
recommendations.rationale: Secrecy gives an advantage and arouses respect, while revealing plans invites criticism and opposition.

recommendations.recommendation: Keep things in suspense and let others not fully grasp your capacities.
recommendations.rationale: Mystery excites veneration; showing everything invites contempt.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid outshining your superiors.
recommendations.rationale: Superiors may accept help but never being surpassed; victories over a master are odious or fatal.

recommendations.recommendation: Associate with those from whom you can learn.
recommendations.rationale: Friendly conversation with the wise is a school of erudition and culture.

recommendations.recommendation: Think with the few and speak with the many.
recommendations.rationale: Going against the current invites danger; the wise keep their opinions and conform outwardly.

recommendations.recommendation: Use human means as if divine help did not exist, and divine means as if human ones did not.
recommendations.rationale: This is the rule of a great master and combines full effort with full trust.
rationale_type: authority of a person or tradition

recommendations.recommendation: Never act in the heat of passion.
recommendations.rationale: Passion clouds reason and leads to mistakes; one should wait until calm.

recommendations.recommendation: Know how to say no gracefully.
recommendations.rationale: A refusal delivered well is more welcome than a grudging yes; one should not refuse bluntly.

recommendations.recommendation: Combine substance with good appearance.
recommendations.rationale: Things pass for what they seem, not what they are; few look inside.

recommendations.recommendation: Know and cultivate your greatest gift.
recommendations.rationale: Many could have excelled had they known their strongest quality.

recommendations.recommendation: Recognize fools and avoid them.
recommendations.rationale: Associating with fools is dangerous and brings misfortune.

recommendations.recommendation: Know how to wait patiently for the right moment.
recommendations.rationale: Time and I against any 2; patience brings ripeness and success.

recommendations.recommendation: Quit while luck favors you; withdraw at the right moment.
recommendations.rationale: Fortune tires of carrying one person long; better to retreat on a high note.

recommendations.recommendation: Trust friends today as if they might become enemies tomorrow.
recommendations.rationale: Neither love nor hate should be permanent; be prepared.

recommendations.recommendation: Never complain.
recommendations.rationale: Complaining damages your reputation and invites others to treat you worse.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid affectation and singularity.
recommendations.rationale: Affectation makes even good qualities seem artificial and invites ridicule.

recommendations.recommendation: Avoid exaggeration and overpromising.
recommendations.rationale: Exaggerated claims reduce credibility and lead to disappointment.

recommendations.recommendation: Find each person's weak spot to move them.
recommendations.rationale: Everyone has a ruling passion; knowing it gives the key to their will.

recommendations.recommendation: Do pleasant things yourself and unpleasant things through others.
recommendations.rationale: Good will attaches to the giver of favors, ill will to the one who punishes.

recommendations.recommendation: Leave others hungry for more.
recommendations.rationale: Desire measures value; satisfying it completely diminishes esteem.

recommendations.recommendation: Learn to forget what is useless or painful.
recommendations.rationale: Memory brings back what hurts and drops what helps; training it is more luck than art.

recommendations.recommendation: Be a saint; virtue completes all other perfections.
recommendations.rationale: Virtue makes one prudent, attentive, wise, brave, and happy; it alone is enough.
